note: All money in USD for both travellers combined. Ranges are [low, high]. Flights are round trips. hotel and daily are per night/day; package covers packageNights of lodging and food. Scores are 1 (worst) to 5 (best) for January/February. leadDays = days before departure the slower passport's paperwork should start.

destinations.name: Germany
destinations.leadWhy: Schengen visa for the Nigerian passport at the German Consulate General in Lagos: appointment wait (at least 3 weeks, often longer) plus 15 days processing, up to 45

events.text: Carnival in Cologne, Dusseldorf and Mainz (Rose Monday 8 Feb)

flags: Hardest visa of the group for the Nigerian passport

destinations.name: Barbados
destinations.leadWhy: No visa for either passport; online immigration and customs form opens 72 hours before arrival; yellow fever card for the Nigerian traveller
flags: Air Peace fare not published (not in the total)
Air Peace flies once or twice a month; a 14-night stay may not fit

destinations.name: Japan
destinations.leadWhy: Japan visa for the Nigerian passport at VFS Lagos or Abuja: at least 12 to 14 working days; fee JPY 15,000 since July 2026

events.text: Lunar New Year week: busier and pricier in Tokyo and Kyoto

destinations.name: Thailand
destinations.leadWhy: Thai e-visa for the Nigerian passport: the embassy in Abuja quotes 15 business days, sometimes 4 to 6 weeks

events.text: Chinese New Year: Bangkok's Chinatown packed (fun, but book ahead)

destinations.name: Vietnam
destinations.leadWhy: Vietnam e-visa for both passports: 3 to 5 working days

events.text: Tet (Lunar New Year, about 6 Feb): closures and sold-out transport

destinations.name: Kenya
destinations.leadWhy: Kenya eTA ($30) and compulsory travel health insurance (from Oct 2026) for the US passport; the Nigerian passport needs no eTA
flags: Safari is most of the cost
Compulsory travel insurance since Oct 2026 (about $50 each, in the total)

destinations.name: Sri Lanka
destinations.leadWhy: The Nigerian passport cannot use the online ETA: a sponsor in Sri Lanka must apply in person at the Department of Immigration (police clearance needed)
flags: Nigerian traveller needs a sponsor in Sri Lanka to get a visa

destinations.name: Senegal
destinations.leadWhy: No visa for either passport (ECOWAS for the Nigerian one); just six months on each passport and an onward ticket
flags: Harmattan dust can haze the sky in January and February

destinations.name: Cape Verde
destinations.leadWhy: EASE pre-registration and airport tax (4,400 escudos) for both, at least 5 days before arrival; ECOWAS keeps the Nigerian passport visa-free

events.text: Mindelo Carnival, Sao Vicente (main parade Tuesday 9 Feb)

flags: Nigerian route goes through Dakar: a connection in Lisbon needs a Schengen transit visa

destinations.name: Malaysia
destinations.leadWhy: Malaysia eVisa for the Nigerian passport: a few working days, but sources disagree, so start three weeks ahead

events.text: Thaipusam at Batu Caves, Kuala Lumpur (22 Jan 2027)
Chinese New Year: Penang and KL festive, but busy and pricier

flags: East-coast islands (Perhentian, Tioman) are closed by the monsoon until about March

destinations.name: Tanzania

package.what: 5-night Serengeti and Ngorongoro lodge safari, park fees and meals included

destinations.leadWhy: Tanzania e-visa for both passports ($100 for Americans); Nigerians left the referral category on 25 Sep 2026, so ordinary processing; allow three weeks

events.text: Wildebeest calving season in the southern Serengeti (roughly late January to February)

flags: Safari is most of the cost
Compulsory $44-a-person insurance for all of Tanzania including Zanzibar (in the total)

destinations.name: Egypt

package.what: 4-night Luxor to Aswan Nile cruise, meals and guided sights included

destinations.leadWhy: Egyptian visa for the Nigerian passport from the embassy in Abuja or consulate in Lagos: no visa on arrival and no e-visa for Nigerians

events.text: Abu Simbel sun festival: sunrise lights the inner sanctuary (22 Feb)

flags: Nigerian traveller needs an embassy visa

destinations.name: Italy
destinations.leadWhy: Schengen visa for the Nigerian passport at TLScontact for the Italian consulate in Lagos: book the appointment early (long waits reported), then 15 days processing, up to 45
flags: Hardest visa of the group, with Germany
